sources.label: Wikipedia, "XO-5b"
sources.quote: XO-5b, formally named Makropulos, is an extrasolar planet approximately 910 light years away in the constellation of Lynx.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around Absolutno. Its orbit and size follow Smith 2015's fit, the archive's default.
